text:
Ravi Patel: Quick sync 1h before marketplace live. Need final go/no-go checklist for press, partner SI handoff, and HW SKU mapping. I'm listing open items, pls ack and own.

Maya Lopez: I'll own press ops. Where are the embargoed asset links?

Ravi Patel: Uploaded to /share/marketplace/embargo/ v2.0. Readme has outlets list and embargo window.

Daniel Kim: SI integration status: connectors green in staging except Azure marketplace billing hook. ETA for fix: 03:30 PT. We'll need partner SIs patched before 08:30 cutover.

Leah Brooks: Landing page ready. CTA variants A/B are staged behind flag `mp_cta_rollout`. I need release window to schedule toggle.

Tom Nguyen: Infra checklist:
- CDN ttl drop to 60s at 05:00 PT
- cache pre-warm at 07:15 PT
- traffic canary 07:30 PT (10%), 07:45 PT (50%), 08:00 PT (100%)
- health checks for quantized endpoints enabled
We'll monitor 5xx and p95 latency.

Priya Shah: Legal notes: embargo list is strict. Partners asked for a 7-minute hold on logos. Use UTC in press timestamps. Add partner-approved microcopy where required.

Maya Lopez: Press dry-run at 06:45 PT. PR_bot will post sample tweet and press headline into #launch-runner (embargoed). Everyone please don't forward.

PR_bot: Dry-run: "[EMBARGOED] Redwood Marketplace launch - headline test" -> Will remove at go time.

Daniel Kim: Re: SI billing hook for Azure - workaround: route billing events to fallback queue until hook patched. I can deploy fallback now, need approval.

Ravi Patel: Approve fallback. Document the rollback and post link to runbook.

Daniel Kim: Deployed fallback queue. Patch ETA 02:40 PT. Noted.

Leah Brooks: Flag schedule request: flip `mp_cta_rollout` at 08:05 PT. Rollback cmd: `ops-bot revert-flag mp_cta_rollout`. I'll be watching.

ops-bot: Scheduled flag flip `mp_cta_rollout` -> ON at 08:05 PT. Audit token: tok-7782.

Tom Nguyen: note: partner hardware SKUs (A100x2, P4d) not mapped in marketplace SKU table for Azure/GS. We need mapping to avoid mis-billing. @Ravi please confirm owner.

Ravi Patel: I'll nudge partner PMs and get SKU mapping into doc by EOD. If not, we will hide those SKUs from public listing at launch.

Maya Lopez: Social cadence: blog + press release at 08:00 PT, tweets at 08:02 PT, partner co-post at 08:10 PT. Partners asked for logos withheld until 08:10 PT.

Priya Shah: Confirmed legal approval for text. Reminder: do not share embargoed assets with third parties early.

Daniel Kim: Canary rollback id prepared: crb-2026-07. If p95 spikes >2s or 5xx >0.5% revert to previous routing.

Leah Brooks: Landing A/B metrics to collect: CTA click-through, marketplace conversion, average latency per call. Post metrics to #launch-metrics every 5 minutes during ramp.

Tom Nguyen: Running preflight now. Will post results at 06:10 PT.

ops-bot: Preflight results: caches OK, canary health checks passing, quantized endpoints healthy. Small warning: cold-start median +20ms on P4d.

Ravi Patel: OK, minor latency variance acceptable. Final owners: Press=Maya, Infra=Tom, SI=Daniel, Landing=Leah, Legal=Priya, SKU mapping=Ravi. Everyone confirm.

Maya Lopez: :thumbsup: confirmed. Will run dry-run and stand by at 06:45 PT.

Daniel Kim: :thumbsup: SI standby 07:00-09:00 PT.

Leah Brooks: :thumbsup: I'll be in #launch-runner to flip flags and monitor A/B.

Priya Shah: :thumbsup: Legal on-call for any last-minute copy asks.

Tom Nguyen: :thumbsup: infra oncall in #infra-ops.

Ravi Patel: Great. Final note: if SKU mapping isn't ready by 07:00 PT we hide HW SKUs and call it out in release notes. See you in #launch-runner at 06:30 PT for final go/no-go.
